distribution: Initial owned profession equipment: one armor, three weapon and five Pickaxe/staff full repairs and five manufactured replacement bolas at 100 percent efficiency. Saved per-character component totals divided across 39 finite chests; historical catalogue retained as provenance.

layout.authority: Approved MAP02_Alcantarillas_Propuesta_v2.png and board 3 dimensions, author confirmation 2026-11-12.
layout.interpretation: Rectilinear construction from the non-uniform conceptual board. Three independent main circuits per sector plus one internal keyless maintenance shortcut. Preserve existing populations, loot identities and lock rules; no claim of twice the current map length.
layout.dimension_basis: Normal total 5 m, continuous dry shelf 3 m, height 3 m; chambers 4 m high; final cistern 7 m. Service/escort links 4 m wide; optional maintenance shortcuts 2 m wide. Existing collision sizes are unchanged.

boss.escape_basis: The approved northern cistern drain is inside the boss chamber; retain a directly reachable retreat target when the player service exit moves outside P4.

return_network.basis: 128 MU width/headroom derives from four existing 32-MU grid cells and exceeds the accepted 74.7-MU maximum actor height. Lower ceiling -32 keeps one grid cell of solid slab under the upper floor. Water reuses the existing 16-MU harmless channel depth; no current or damage. Elevator uses the accepted MAP01 speed 16. Pits retain their 128x128 openings; no ladder or stair exit.
return_network.activation: Four independent permanent keyless grates: south/west/east/north, opened only from outside the lift enclosure below the upper slab. Use at either face then calls the platform from either landing; Use from inside sends it to the other landing.
return_network.progression_rule: Author approved on 2026-10-02: a closed block keeps all its trapdoor covers solid/inactive, including for enemies, until the normal keyed entrance opens. This prevents upward jumps through remotely opened pits. South is initially accessible.

return_routing.basis: Shortest deterministic grid path to the existing central ring, avoiding moving surface panels and gates. Native slabs isolate closed sectors; existing pit activation guards remain authoritative.

refuges.resource_allowance: none; known recipes and existing finite salvage only
